# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
project/
├── Dockerfile
├── .dockerignore
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── src/
    └── index.ts
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# =============================================================================
# Stage 1: Base — shared foundation with common configuration
# =============================================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS base

# Set working directory for all subsequent stages
WORKDIR /app

# Install dumb-init for proper signal handling and process management
# This ensures graceful shutdowns and correct PID 1 behavior
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# =============================================================================
# Stage 2: Dependencies — install ALL dependencies (including devDependencies)
# =============================================================================
FROM base AS dependencies

# Copy only package files first to leverage Docker layer caching
# This layer is only invalidated when package files change
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install all dependencies including devDependencies needed for TypeScript compilation
# --frozen-lockfile ensures reproducible builds (fails if lockfile is outdated)
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# =============================================================================
# Stage 3: Builder — compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# =============================================================================
FROM dependencies AS builder

# Copy TypeScript configuration
COPY tsconfig.json ./

# Copy source code
COPY src/ ./src/

# Compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# Output goes to /app/dist as configured in tsconfig.json
RUN npm run build

# =============================================================================
# Stage 4: Production Dependencies — install only production dependencies
# =============================================================================
FROM base AS production-dependencies

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install ONLY production dependencies, skipping devDependencies
# This creates a clean, minimal node_modules for the final image
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --omit=dev

# =============================================================================
# Stage 5: Final — minimal production image
# =============================================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS final

# Install dumb-init in the final stage as well
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# Create a non-root user and group for security
# Running as root in containers is a security risk
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs && \
    adduser  --system --uid 1001 --ingroup nodejs nodeuser

WORKDIR /app

# Copy production node_modules from the production-dependencies stage
COPY --from=production-dependencies --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy compiled JavaScript from the builder stage
COPY --from=builder --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/dist ./dist

# Copy package.json for runtime metadata (version, name, etc.)
COPY --chown=nodeuser:nodejs package.json ./

# Switch to non-root user
USER nodeuser

# Expose the application port
EXPOSE 3000

# Set NODE_ENV to production for performance optimizations
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Health check to verify the application is running correctly
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=15s --retries=3 \
    CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health', (r) => { process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1) })" \
    || exit 1

# Use dumb-init as the entrypoint to handle signals properly
# It acts as PID 1 and forwards signals to the Node.js process
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]

# Start the application using the compiled JavaScript
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Supporting Files

### .dockerignore
```dockerignore
# Version control
.git
.gitignore

# Dependencies (will be installed fresh in Docker)
node_modules

# TypeScript source (only compiled output is needed in final image)
src

# Build artifacts that should be rebuilt
dist

# Development and config files
.env
.env.*
*.env
.eslintrc*
.prettierrc*
jest.config*
*.test.ts
*.spec.ts
__tests__/

# Documentation
README.md
CHANGELOG.md
docs/

# Docker files themselves
Dockerfile
.dockerignore
docker-compose*.yml

# OS artifacts
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# IDE files
.vscode/
.idea/
*.swp
*.swo

# Logs
logs/
*.log
npm-debug.log*

# Coverage reports
coverage/
.nyc_output/
```

### tsconfig.json
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": false,
    "sourceMap": false,
    "removeComments": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noImplicitReturns": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.spec.ts"]
}
```

### package.json
```json
{
  "name": "my-typescript-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Node.js TypeScript application",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node src/index.ts",
    "lint": "eslint src/**/*.ts",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  }
}
```

### src/index.ts (Example Application)
```typescript
import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

app.use(express.json());

// Health check endpoint (used by Docker HEALTHCHECK)
app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.status(200).json({
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    uptime: process.uptime(),
  });
});

app.get('/', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({ message: 'Hello from TypeScript!' });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});

export default app;
```

## Build and Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image with a specific tag
docker build --tag my-ts-app:latest .

# Build with build arguments for flexibility
docker build \
  --tag my-ts-app:1.0.0 \
  --label "build.date=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" \
  --label "build.version=1.0.0" \
  .

# Run the container
docker run \
  --detach \
  --name my-ts-app \
  --publish 3000:3000 \
  --env NODE_ENV=production \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  my-ts-app:latest

# Inspect the final image size
docker image inspect my-ts-app:latest --format='{{.Size}}' | \
  awk '{printf "Image size: %.2f MB\n", $1/1024/1024}'

# View all intermediate stage sizes
docker history my-ts-app:latest

# Test the health endpoint
curl http://localhost:3000/health
```

## Stage Summary

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Multi-Stage Build Flow                        │
├──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Stage                │ Purpose                                  │
├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ base                 │ Alpine + dumb-init foundation            │
│ dependencies         │ All deps (dev + prod) for compilation    │
│ builder              │ TypeScript → JavaScript compilation      │
│ production-deps      │ Production-only node_modules             │
│ final                │ Minimal image: compiled JS + prod deps   │
└──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘

What gets EXCLUDED from the final image:
  ✗ TypeScript source files (src/)
  ✗ TypeScript compiler (typescript package)
  ✗ Type definitions (@types/*)
  ✗ Development dependencies
  ✗ tsconfig.json
  ✗ Build tools and linters
```

## Key Optimizations Explained

| Technique | Benefit |
|---|---|
| `node:20-alpine` base | ~5x smaller than `node:20` (debian) |
| Multi-stage builds | Dev tools never reach the final image |
| `npm ci` over `npm install` | Reproducible, faster, lockfile-enforced |
| `--omit=dev` in prod stage | Excludes all devDependencies |
| Copy `package.json` before source | Maximizes layer cache reuse |
| Non-root user | Improved container security |
| `dumb-init` | Proper signal handling, no zombie processes |
| `.dockerignore` | Prevents unnecessary files in build context |
